llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed wrapper for a paid/cloud image-generation CLI, with the main risks being expected API-key use, uploads of user-selected files, and optional local saves.

dimensions.detail: Network calls to api.dlazy.com/files.dlazy.com, upload of user-provided local media paths, and optional output download via --save are proportionate for a cloud image-generation service and are documented.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a pinned npm CLI package or pinned npx invocation. This is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should recognize it relies on an external CLI package not bundled in the skill artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger keywords include generic image-generation phrases, so an agent could invoke this skill for broad image requests unless the user or platform scopes activation clearly.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The CLI can persist an API key in ~/.dlazy/config.json and a global npm install can persist the CLI binary; both behaviors are disclosed, scoped to the service, and revocable or avoidable via DLAZY_API_KEY/npx.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Nano Banana 2 image generation/editing, and the documented capabilities match that purpose: install or run a pinned dLazy CLI, send prompts and selected media to dLazy endpoints, and return generated image URLs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you intend to use dLazy's hosted image service. Prompts and any media paths you provide may be uploaded to dLazy, API use may consume credits, login can store an API key locally, and --save writes files to the path you choose. Use the pinned npx command instead of a global install if you do not want a persistent CLI binary.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced Chinese skill file was present and inspected; it mirrors the English instructions and does not add hidden or incompatible behavior.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger phrases are a real usability/scoping concern because they overlap with ordinary image requests, but they do not show deception or malicious behavior.
[P9] expected: The reported whitespace occurs in wide markdown table formatting; manual inspection found no concealed instructions below or beyond the visible content.
[SQP-2] expected: The --save option writes generated assets to a local path and creates directories; this is documented in the option text, though users should choose save paths intentionally.
[SQP-3] expected: The bilingual English/Chinese documentation is coherent with the linked localized files and does not impose unsafe behavior.
[AIG SARIF] expected: The static scan reported no security findings.
